Navigation operation counts are not constructor timing or bundle-size improvements. The timed fixture has default settings disabled.
ENG-PERF-01 and ENG-PERF-02 remain open. Timing results include constructor and teardown review signals.
No physical device, heap/GPU leak, external SDK, remote CI or release validation is implied.
